>
[Swarmeater's Clasp](/Equipment.aspx?ID=818)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Agents of Edgewatch</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under](/Sources.aspx?ID=47) pg. 76, [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 154 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 460 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These small brooches usually feature carved reliefs of verminous, swarming creatures. When you wear the clasp, you gain resistance 10 to physical damage from swarm creatures.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact, manipulate;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** a [swarm](/Traits.aspx?ID=239) creature is within your reach; **Effect** You thrust your hand into the swarm, draw forth a squirming mass of vermin, and devour it. You recover 3d10+8 Hit Points and deal the same amount of bludgeoning damage to the swarm. The Hit Point recovery is a [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=128) [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89) effect.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
